# Global Untold Story

> Full-service film and video production studio based in Egypt, serving the Middle East, North Africa (MENA) and international clients — from concept and shooting through post-production, localization and distribution.

Film and video production studio based at Egyptian Media Production City in Cairo, with offices in Dubai and Jeddah.

Site: https://globaluntoldstory.com
Contact: https://globaluntoldstory.com/contact
Email: bendary@globaluntoldstory.com
Phone: +201001299639 (Egypt) · +971547711772 (UAE)

## Key facts

- Brand name: Global Untold Story
- Founder / CEO: Khaled Bendary
- Headquarters: Egyptian Media Production City, 6th of October City, Giza, Egypt
- Offices: Cairo (Egypt), Business Bay — Dubai (UAE), Jeddah (Saudi Arabia)
- Serves: Egypt, UAE, Saudi Arabia and the wider MENA region, plus international productions filming in the region

## What we do

Full-cycle production for international and regional clients: on-ground production in Egypt (permits, fixing, crew, equipment, locations, logistics), commercial advertising, documentary, corporate and industrial film, live events and broadcast, podcast, post-production, motion/CGI/VFX/AI, dubbing and localisation, commercial photography, performance marketing, and original IP.
